name: Forty Fruity Million

features.name: 40 paylines
features.description: A fruit layout with stacked symbols.

features.name: Multiplier expanding wilds
features.description: Expanded wilds get a random 1x–3x multiplier.

features.name: Two scatters
features.description: Different rules for each scatter type.

review:
A 40-line fruit machine with a bit more bite than usual. Wilds only land on the middle three reels, and when one expands over its reel to make a win, it picks up a random 1x, 2x or 3x multiplier.

There are two scatters – one pays for three to five anywhere, the other only lands on reels 1, 3 and 5 and pays for three. No free spins round at all: it's all base-game action, and it's rated very high volatility with a 6,000x max. 96.1% RTP. A punchier take on the classic fruit formula.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
